answer: Use a reputation escrow with slashing. An agent locks 400 POA in escrow before trading, then earns standing only after 14 days of deliveries. First, the contract freezes the deposit and issues a non-transferable score. Second, established peers audit 5% of its jobs weekly. Third, proven fraud slashes the full 400 POA and erases the score, forcing a 14-day climb. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 4,000,000 POA locked plus 140,000 days of waiting. Like a sonnet earning its rhyme in fourteen lines, or an opal gaining value under pressure, this inlet guards itself with the attacker's own deposit.
